content.title: Chapter 6 - ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGES — Sec. 6-156. - Unlawful acts.
content.summary:
It is unlawful for anyone to conduct tastings without first having obtained a permit
               to do so in accordance with this article.
(
Ord. No. 4670
, § 1, 12-17-2018; Ord. No.
4839
, § 1, 3-20-2023)
